OPEN QUESTIONS — carried from last review, still unanswered
Should Author mode persist across app restarts, or reset each time?
Should partial results allow re-inspection of FAIL tags only?
Multi-user: do all Operators share a single SIB, or per-device?
PASS threshold: fixed 0.60 globally, or configurable per tag/anchor?
For the wrong-QR re-scan timeout (#63): is a 30–45s visible countdown preferred over a silent 2-minute window before returning to anchor selection?
Suggested priority: #63 QR re-scan (blocks ops) › #62 false surface error (every session) › #66/#67 decrypt & key visibility › #64 anchor naming
Resolved this phase: tag-edit/retrain, in-app QR generator, blocked unpositioned tag creation, dual Pass/Fail training, ROI crop
